packages.title: Andaman Quick Escape – Port Blair & Havelock 3N/4D
packages.summary: Radhanagar Beach sunset, Elephant Beach snorkelling, Cellular Jail.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair – Cellular Jail
itinerary.description: Pickup at Port Blair airport and check-in. Afternoon at Corbyn's Cove beach, then visit the Cellular Jail national memorial and its evening light & sound show. Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Port Blair – Havelock – Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to the jetty for the ferry to Havelock (about 2 hrs). After check-in, spend the afternoon and sunset at Radhanagar Beach. Overnight stay on Havelock.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkelling
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a boat ride to Elephant Beach for snorkelling over the coral reef (one guided session included); optional sea walk or jet ski at own cost. Evening at Kalapathar Beach. Overnight stay on Havelock.

itinerary.title: Havelock – Port Blair Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and morning ferry back to Port Blair, then drop at the airport (afternoon flights recommended). Tour ends.

packages.title: Andaman Extended Explorer with Baratang 8N/9D
packages.summary: Slow-paced Andaman with Baratang's caves and mangroves and free days on Havelock and Neil.
highlights: Slow-paced Andaman with Baratang's caves and mangroves and free days on Havelock and Neil.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair – Cellular Jail
itinerary.description: Pickup at Port Blair airport and check-in. Afternoon at Corbyn's Cove beach, then visit the Cellular Jail national memorial and its evening light & sound show. Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Baratang Island Day Trip
itinerary.description: Very early start by road through the forest reserve (convoy rules apply) to Baratang. Boat through mangrove creeks and walk to the limestone caves; visit the mud volcano. Return to Port Blair by evening. Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Port Blair – Havelock – Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to the jetty for the ferry to Havelock (about 2 hrs). After check-in, spend the afternoon and sunset at Radhanagar Beach. Overnight stay on Havelock.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkelling
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a boat ride to Elephant Beach for snorkelling over the coral reef (one guided session included); optional sea walk or jet ski at own cost. Evening at Kalapathar Beach. Overnight stay on Havelock.

itinerary.title: Havelock at Leisure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a free day on Havelock – try a discover-scuba dive or mangrove kayaking (own cost), or relax at the beach. Overnight stay on Havelock.

itinerary.title: Havelock – Neil Island
itinerary.description: Breakfast and ferry to Neil Island (about 1 hr). Visit the Natural Bridge rock formation at low tide and watch sunset at Laxmanpur Beach. Overnight stay on Neil.

itinerary.title: Neil Island at Leisure
itinerary.description: Sunrise at Sitapur Beach and a relaxed day on Neil – swim at Bharatpur Beach or cycle through the village and farms. Overnight stay on Neil.

itinerary.title: Neil – Port Blair – Ross Island
itinerary.description: Morning ferry to Port Blair and afternoon boat to Ross Island (closed Wednesdays) with its British-era ruins. Evening shopping in Aberdeen Bazaar. Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Departure from Port Blair
itinerary.description: Breakfast, a visit to the Samudrika naval marine museum or local market if time allows, and drop at Port Blair airport. Tour ends.
